what: Which fables are “most positive” or “most negative”?
title: sentiment
text: Bing: net sentiment per fable (positive minus negative) AFINN: mean score per fable
code: bing_tab <- with(   aesops_bing,   table(fable_id, sentiment) )  # Some fables may not have both labels present; guard with checks pos <- if ("positive" %in% colnames(bing_tab)) bing_tab[, "positive"] else rep(0, nrow(bing_tab)) neg <- if ("negative" %in% colnames(bing_tab)) bing_tab[, "negative"] else rep(0, nrow(bing_tab))  bing_net <- pos - neg bing_net <- sort(bing_net)  # Most negative head(bing_net, 10)  # Most positive tail(bing_net, 10) afinn_mean <- tapply(aesops_afinn$value, aesops_afinn$fable_id, mean) afinn_mean <- sort(afinn_mean)  # Lowest mean scores head(afinn_mean, 10)  # Highest mean scores tail(afinn_mean, 10)
